checks: visitors see the labelled sample world while nothing is published
the editor asks visitors to sign in and shows no editing controls
wrong passwords and non-enrolled accounts are refused, in the UI and by the database (403)
the enrolled owner saves a revision-guarded draft that visitors cannot see
uploads are registered, stored privately as resized WebP, and shown to editors through signed URLs
a failed upload is reported, its reservation is cleaned up, and the draft keeps the previous image
publishing copies the upload to its public name and publishes exactly the saved revision to visitors
a stale save is refused with the current revision, keeps the edit, and saves only on explicit choice
after the session ends, the failed save keeps the input; signing in again and retrying saves it
changing the password needs the current one; afterwards only the new password signs in
the database validates the whole document (422) when the client is bypassed
an unreachable service shows an error with Try again instead of a stuck loader, and recovers
only the URL and publishable key are configured in the browser
